injuries.detail: Carter (illness) practiced with the G League's Maine Celtics on Wednesday.
Miller (groin) won't return to Friday's game against the Celtics, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Schroder (thigh) is out for Friday's game versus Boston.
Diabate (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Boston, according to the Hornets' official injury report.
Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.
The Hornets recalled Williams (hamstring) from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Wednesday.
